title: Getting Started
description: Welcome to Markdown Notes! This guide will help you understand the basics.
steps: Click 'Sign in with Google' on the home page to access your notes securely.
Once signed in, you will see your Dashboard where all your notes are displayed.

title: Creating & Editing Notes
description: Learn how to write and manage your markdown notes.
steps: Click the circular '+' button in the bottom right corner to create a new note.
The editor will open. Type your note using Markdown for formatting (like **bold** or *italics*).
To edit an existing note, click on it from the Dashboard, then click the pencil icon at the bottom.
Notes are saved automatically when you close the editor or click outside.

title: Organizing Notes
description: Keep your workspace tidy by pinning and archiving.
steps: To keep a note at the top of your list, hover over the note and click the 'Pin' icon.
If you don't need a note right now but want to keep it, hover over it and click the 'Archive' button.
Archived notes move to the 'Archive' folder in the left sidebar.

title: Searching & Finding Notes
description: Quickly find the information you need.
steps: Use the Search bar at the top of the screen to find specific words inside your notes.
The search will instantly filter your currently visible active notes.

title: Deleting Notes
description: How to remove notes and recover them if needed.
steps: To delete a note, hover over it and click the Trash icon.
The note will move to the 'Trash' folder in the sidebar.
Notes in the Trash will be permanently deleted automatically after 3 days.
To restore a note, go to the Trash folder and click the 'Restore' icon on the note.
To permanently delete it immediately, click the 'Delete Forever' icon in the Trash folder.

title: Layout & Theming
description: Customize how Markdown Notes looks on your screen.
steps: Click the Grid/List icon in the top right corner to change how notes are displayed.
Click the Sun/Moon icon in the top right corner to switch between Light and Dark mode.
Click the menu (hamburger) icon in the top left to expand or collapse the sidebar menu.

title: Storage Limits
steps: Your account has a maximum storage limit of 10MB.
You can view your current storage usage at the bottom of the expanded left sidebar.
If you reach the limit, you will need to delete older notes to make room for new ones.
